fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: NEW scoped body/unit completion plus inherited identity preservation
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: Instantiate a creature with a stable actorId, dossierId, source hash, encounterId, body-part IDs, original creator/controller when applicable, and an explicit lifecycle. A name, artwork, court, title, CR or alias is not an acquisition, spell list or resource account. All printed size/type/CR/XP/AC/HP/abilities/defenses remain the native values. The separate living/nonliving lifecycle below is authored data, not a change of type. Ordinary printed profiles have one ordinary Action per actual regular turn, one ordinary Reaction refreshed at their actual regular START, actual movement and no free Bonus Action. Native Multiattack supplies subattacks inside one Action; it supplies no extra turn. No CR-derived PB is invented: printed attack modifiers/DCs control; otherwise unlisted ability checks/saves use the printed natural modifier only. Skills require an actual separate entitlement. A source-defined character, companion or spell-created profile keeps its own lifecycle; a matching bestiary name does not overwrite it. All supplied fixture instances are synthetic encounter instantiations, not authenticated campaign spawns.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: 66 printed dossiers; source-only lore dossier gains no actor

fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: For these proposed profiles only use the explicit per-body box and weight in each procedure. Occupancy is the interior of that box; mere boundary contact is not overlap. A body cannot voluntarily end in solid matter or another body's interior. Range/reach is minimum Euclidean separation between actual occupied bodies; a target can be hit at exactly the stated maximum. An area needs a real interior intersection and line of effect from its declared outlet/center to a point in that same intersection. No witness on an unexposed face suffices. Cone geometry is axial 0<s<=length and perpendicular radius<=s/2, excluding the rear half-space. A spherical area uses its stated center/radius. Whole-body fit and actual collision/support are required throughout movement and arrival. Positive-body intersection, not a token-center test, governs these local areas. These shapes do not replace another accepted spell's grid/continuous conventions. Sight/perception, cover, light and knowledge are separate: knowing a location supplies no sight. Native ranged attacks within five feet of a hostile creature that sees the attacker use the actual close-combat disadvantage. Real half/three-quarter cover adds its actual +2/+5; total cover blocks the required path. A larger body neither sees nor attacks through a wall by default.

An ordinary native attack can be used as one Action. Multiattack commits one Action, records its chosen permitted sequence and resolves the printed count in order, choosing legal recipients and actual available body outlets for each subattack. NEW: any listed damaging attack procedure, including a save-based or recharge action, can occupy one slot; a recharge action is available only while its real charge exists, consumes that charge at its own commitment, and cannot be repeated from the same charge. This gives effect to 'using the actions below' without inventing additional Actions. A miss still spends its slot. An illegal later subattack may select another otherwise legal recipient before its own commitment; it cannot change an already rolled result, add an unlisted effect or refund the Action. Actual incapacitation or source/target removal stops whatever can no longer legally occur. Each genuine subattack is a new original-dealer damage root; multiattack parent action ID and subattack ordinal remain recorded. The full native Action is one source-use for a conversion entitlement unless an actual external contract explicitly says otherwise; subattack descendants cannot multiply the same converted use. Root identity and source-use identity are distinct. Counterspell cannot interrupt an untagged nonspell attack merely because its damage is magical. Ordinary Ready triggers finish first; a telegraph supplies no new interrupt or Reaction.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: all 162 printed actions and three separately labelled tactic completions

fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: INHERIT exact Core/Healing/Null; NEW lifecycle bindings
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: Resolve attack rolls with natural1 miss/natural20 hit and doubled dice only, not doubled flat modifiers. A save is binary meeting DC; natural20 is not automatic save success. Use actual typed defenses and temporary HP, then actual normal-HP loss and overkill. CORE ordering: lethal instant-death threshold precedes a living recipient's Wound check; otherwise one qualifying Wound check occurs on positive-to-zero or post-temp damage at least half effective maximum. DC=max(10,floor(post-temp/2)); subtract pre-event Wounds from the CON save. Failure adds one Wound; a fourth Wound kills. Failure by at least5 also uses the actual d6 injury result. Do not reduce maximum HP merely because a Wound was added: Critical's ordinary-heal ceiling is not a maximum-HP clamp. Ordinary monsters reaching zero die/end after their actual life sequence unless a real valid knockout or source override applies. Significant-NPC death-save handling must be declared before the event. Death is distinct from zero, suppression, disappearance, and harvest availability. Each attack names the creature as dealer; controller Null does not transfer to it. A qualifying actual Null root inherits its original dealer snapshot; it prevents only the applicable damage-caused lethal/Wound endpoint and keeps non-damage costs and riders. Ordinary living profiles use Stable0 and the one actual Stable clock. Printed Constructs are explicitly nonliving Constructs and use accepted Null Disabled0 without creating salvage. NEW for only the four printed Undead here: ordinary damage at zero destroys the same body into its finite native remains; a qualifying Null root instead leaves the same nonliving body Null Disabled0, no corpse/soul/loot. This is not the named Silence Wraith projection rule, a resurrection, generic repair or a global Undead physiology. Only a real compatible recovery source restores a disabled nonliving body. Roots, life events and finite-remains claims are durable and idempotent. Existing Core detail: each Wound penalizes CON saves and normal Hit-Dice recovery maximum by1 only; at3Wounds Critical gives Speed-10ft and ordinary-heal ceiling max(1,effectiveMaximum-1), not maximum-HP loss. Actual linked injury d6:1Concussion(-1future Initiative/Perception),2OffensiveTrauma(-1attacks),3MobilityTrauma(-5nonteleportSpeeds),4FineMotor(-1tools/manipulationDEX),5Exertion(-1STR/DEXabilitychecks),6Cognitive(-1INT/WIS/CHAabilitychecks). Identical/different applicable Injury penalties use their actual strongest-only rule; separate Wound CON penalty remains. Removing the linked Wound removes its injury, not damage or spent resources.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: named native profiles; no change to external companion/Simulacrum sources

fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: NEW completion of eight printed recharge actions
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: A recharge record stores actorId/actionId, ready/spent, original last-use event, first-use telegraph START, and roll receipts. At genuine encounter activation the printed recharge is ready but first use cannot commit until the next actual regular START after its observable charge cue; out-of-initiative the same initial delay is six real seconds. No hidden prior warning is assumed in a case. After use, roll one real d6 at each later regular START while spent:5 or6 restores readiness,1..4 does not. Extra turns, reactions, entry/reentry, reload or a duplicate START receipt do not roll again. Only the first use requires the printed one-round advance cue; later successful recharge produces its observable cue at that START but adds no invented round delay. Readiness is retained if the creature elects another Action. A cue is observable only through actual senses and paths; its absence from a character's knowledge does not erase the attack. Damaging sound names are not automatically hearing predicates or verbal spell components. Preserve real incapacitation/outlet and source suppression limits. A round of warning permits normal movement, Guard/Brace/Ready or retreat; it never grants a free Reaction or a new mid-resolution interrupt.

fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: NEW explicit native magic tags; reuse external suppression scope
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: Each selected action and trait records physical/biological or magical-nonspell expression. Printed names alone do not grant a new spell rank, RP pool, metamagic, class feature, disease, drain or summoning. For a magical expression, use the suppressor's actual scope: suppression can prevent a prospective activation/expression, not refund a committed native Action, replay a lost trigger, pause the absolute deadline or undo completed damage/ordinary movement. Requiring a physical outlet does not secretly add V/S/F spell components. A failed local magical trait cannot erase the real body or its mundane gear. Native magical nonspell damage can qualify for an actually operative Supreme enhancement; Arc Furnace's spell-only benefit does not thereby include it. Actual Singularity can absorb eligible local magic and settle one conversion per original source-use under its accepted receipt; no arbitrary new RP price or nominal CR value is assigned to an unpriced native action. Actual protected bodies/removal permissions remain source-specific. The accepted fields are not automatically present in any encounter.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: native tagged expressions; external fields only if actually supplied

fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: INHERIT LAX/EX58; NEW finite observation action
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: Retain each dossier's knowledge skill alternatives and its three actual DC thresholds. A focused identification attempt uses one real Search/Research Action in combat with actual observable signs or examined remains, or one uninterrupted minute of ordinary examination outside combat. Use the real acquired skill and underlying ability, actual helpers and conditions; no stat-block or hidden roster is supplied merely by selecting a UI row. Meeting successive printed thresholds reveals only the corresponding family/habitat/dominant type, actual first counter/telegraph, then relevant weakness/harvest/retreat facts. A failed attempt does not create false certainty; an identical unaltered evidence check cannot be spammed. New direct observations can update specific facts without retroactively exposing unknown identities. Recognizing a creature is not knowing its language, reading its contract or receiving a public route. LAX keeps speaking/comprehension/reading/writing/script and physical channels distinct. Individual proposed language competencies below are explicit NEW roster defaults, not grants to observers, all members of an ancestry or unnamed populations. Actual anatomy, silence, hearing, light and usable writing tools still govern communication. Social credentials and promises use actual EX58 records; a failed negotiation is not an invented charm, compelled confession or global reputation loss.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: known dossiers only; five sealed dossiers remain containment metadata

fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: INHERIT finite harvest/custody; NEW donor-row quantities
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: Actual death/destruction creates at most one persistent remains identity for the original unit. Register a finite manifest once, before extraction rolls: source actor, dossier/hash, original body parts, real attached gear, already consumed/lost parts, category availability, actual extraction authority, and disjoint reserve units. A split corpse, severed part, alias, restored projection or retry cannot create a second original yield. Printed per-category percentages are evaluated once with logged d100<=percentage as availability, not automatic inventory; whole-body size supplies one combined Core unit pool (Tiny1,Small1d2,Medium1d4,Large2d4,Huge4d4). That pool is rolled once and allocated among actually available recoverable categories before the lead chooses what to extract, not rolled separately for every row. NEW default allocation chooses one uniform eligible-category starting ordinal, then round-robin in printed row order up to declared anatomical caps; the lead cannot redirect omitted categories into the most expensive one. A partial harvest forfeits unselected ordinary categories under the actual generic rule. Source-qualified reserve units are separately identified before use and never created to satisfy an awarded count. A specific body's surviving anatomy can cap a category below the pool. Native specific skill/DC/base time govern its dossier route; missing Shardling/Sentinel fields receive the explicit new values below. Identification remains the actual knowledge/Medicine procedure. On a genuine extraction Success recover the selected units; Critical Success additionally recovers one previously damaged but still recoverable selected unit, never beyond the registered cap; Failure ruins the highest-value selected unit and recovers none; Critical Failure ruins all selected units and applies the declared actual hazard, or the Core's1d4 minor accident if none exists. NEW work-clock completion: an interrupted ordinary extraction retains only recorded actual active seconds and physically usable partial work; the lead resumes the remaining requirement if the same units still qualify. No time credits while paused, studying, traveling, resting or doing another task. This is a local extraction ledger, not research/manufacturing phases or a global scheduler tick. A completed failed/critically failed selection is exhausted and cannot begin a new generic attempt. A paused unfinished selection gets no new yield roll or stock. No free reroll/yield refresh. A source-qualified actual helper contributes only through the applicable current rule, never from unit count or body parts. Parts from sentient recipients require the real consent/authority/dark-path permission the crafting source demands; this review grants none. Field extraction is not creation, so FT84's Craftsman completion does not halve it. Raw names such as meat do not establish edibility, ingredient identity or a meal. Keep donor-local unit identity, actual weight/container, Tier and reference value; EX58 governs actual custody, transport, lawful settlement and actual buyer valuation. Do not add inventory and also credit the same unit as Supply. No harvest occurs on living, Stable0, NullDisabled, sequestered, absent or merely released creatures. NEW allocation clarification: when several eligible source categories compete for a small total pool, choose a uniform initial category ordinal once, then distribute round-robin in source order within actual anatomy/mass caps. All categories can be actual outcomes; no highest-value choice or global duplicate drop is introduced. This allocation is frozen before worker selection.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: all 178 known harvest occurrences; external spell-created remains use their own source

fullSelectedSharedRules.kind: NEW finite tactical choice; INHERIT actual movement/EX58
fullSelectedSharedRules.wording: At each actual regular START choose from the creature's real perceptions, remembered observations and declared objective: an actual legal source-specific objective/counter first; otherwise the printed How It Fights opening attack, a ready announced area only if its visible recipients suit the objective, then a legal native sequence. A failed path or unavailable target does not grant hidden location knowledge or teleportation. A territorial withdrawal decision and an intelligent surrender/parley are choices, not conditions that remove a player's agency. To disengage under threat the creature must spend its own actual Withdraw/Disengage Action and actual movement, or bear ordinary opportunity-attack risk; no guaranteed escape or unearned pursuit distance. Exact route geometry, hazards, loads and chase transitions come from actual EX58 inputs. Adjacent enemies, line of sight and cover are recomputed before each real movement segment. Real retreat leaves actual cargo, mounts, downed bodies and witness histories where their sources place them; success awards no second kill, material bundle, generic XP or faction change. An encounter boundary does not reset resource/source receipts unless their actual rule says it does.
fullSelectedSharedRules.scope: 66 native actors; authored objectives are scene inputs, not campaign assertions

tradeoffs: Printed Multiattack counts remain useful; recharge/save options occupy existing slots rather than extra actions. This can produce a stronger combined action than a separate-Action interpretation, explicitly selected from the native actions-below wording.

Distributed units keep one HP/action/reaction/yield ledger across actual members; area hits use one least-protected eligible witness, no hidden cover from a sheltered member. This preserves tactical spacing without multiplying printed output.
Pressure Wave selects a bounded5ftpush/Prone only on failure, with no cone or extra damage beyond printed3d8force/DC15.
Real finite physical seals/anchors make narrative counters actionable. Their new dimensions/HP/DCs are source-local authoring, not cosmological objects or universal counter rules.

Material units use new local weights and a finite body pool; random starting category before selection keeps small-pool bodies capable of yielding later categories without letting players steer every unit to the highest price.

Current source body-level harvest time/DC/skill controls removal; accepted generic identification/failure/custody/spoil mechanics remain. No double pool, retry refresh or automatically matching recipe ingredient.
Current explicit field interfaces can affect actual magical nonspell native expressions; no field is assumed active in these encounter examples and no CR-derived price is invented.
New language rosters preserve usable negotiation, but reading/speaking modes and known credentials remain real LAX/EX58 predicates, not universal comprehension.
Unknown exact recipe identities and actual provision-prey/site inputs remain narrow content holds. They do not cancel the printed native attacks, traits or complete known recipe-card behavior.
